cadence: Two latest finalized reports per game/session within a bounded 14-day source query. Actual source dates retained; scheduled refresh, not live results.
coverage: Six Oregon report families. Source-reported winners are not verified distinct tickets or people. No retailer allocation or complete statewide claims coverage.
